name: web_search
description: Search the web and return results with excerpts from the pages found. Use it to look up current facts, news, and topics that need live sources

objective.description: What the search should find or accomplish, stated in plain words.

search_queries.description: Keyword queries to search with. At least one is required.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

max_chars_total.description: The most source text to return, counted in characters across all results.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: flight_search
description: Search for flights between airports on given dates and return matching flights with prices. Use it to compare flight options for a trip

origins.description: Departure airport codes, such as SFO. At least one is required.

destinations.description: Arrival airport codes, such as ORD. At least one is required.

departure_date.description: The day the trip leaves, as YYYY-MM-DD.

return_date.description: The day the trip returns, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for a one-way trip.

adults.description: How many adult travellers there are.

children.description: How many child travellers there are.

infants_in_seat.description: How many infants travel in a seat of their own.

infants_on_lap.description: How many infants travel on an adult lap.

cabin.description: The cabin class to search for.

max_stops.description: The most stops a returned flight may have.

max_price.description: The highest total price to return.

currency.description: The currency prices should be returned in.

max_duration_minutes.description: The longest travel time to return, in minutes.

include_airlines.description: Only return flights from these airlines.

exclude_airlines.description: Leave out flights from these airlines.

departure_hours.description: Departure times to allow, as hours of the day.

arrival_hours.description: Arrival times to allow, as hours of the day.

return_hours.description: Return departure times to allow, as hours of the day.

return_arrival_hours.description: Return arrival times to allow, as hours of the day.

sort.description: How to order the flights returned.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

name: hotel_search
description: Search for hotels in a place for given check-in and check-out dates and return matching stays with prices. Use it to compare places to stay

location.description: The place to stay in, such as a city or neighbourhood name.

check_in_date.description: The first day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

check_out_date.description: The day the stay ends, as YYYY-MM-DD.

children_ages.description: The age of each child staying.

property_types.description: The kinds of property to return, such as hotels or apartments.

min_price.description: The lowest nightly price to return.

max_price.description: The highest nightly price to return.

min_rating.description: The lowest guest rating to return.

free_cancellation.description: Set to true to only return stays that can be cancelled for free.

sort.description: How to order the stays returned.

currency.description: The currency prices should be returned in.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: image_search
description: Search the web for images that match a topic and return image results. Use it when pictures are needed rather than text pages

objective.description: What the search should find or accomplish, stated in plain words.

search_queries.description: Keyword queries to search with. At least one is required.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: place_search
description: Search for real places such as restaurants, shops, and landmarks in or near a location. Use it to find places and their details

query.description: What to look for, such as coffee shops or a place name.

location.description: The area to search in, as a place name.

latitude.description: The latitude of the centre of the search area.

longitude.description: The longitude of the centre of the search area.

max_distance_km.description: How far from the centre to search, in kilometres.

open_now.description: Set to true to only return places that are open right now.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: shopping_search
description: Search shopping listings for products and return matches with prices. Use it to find something to buy or to compare product prices

search_queries.description: Product names or keywords to search for. At least one is required.

objective.description: What the search should find or accomplish, stated in plain words.

condition.description: The condition of the products to return: new, used, or refurbished.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: extract_pages
description: Read one or more web pages in full and return their content, focused on an objective if one is given. Use it when search excerpts are not enough and the actual page content is needed

urls.description: The full web addresses of the pages to read. At least one is required.

objective.description: What to pull out of the pages, stated in plain words.

search_queries.description: Optional keyword queries that point at the parts of the pages that matter.

max_chars_total.description: The most source text to return, counted in characters across all results.

session_id.description: An optional id that groups related calls into one session.

client_model.description: An optional label naming the model that made the call.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

name: web_decisions
description: Weigh a set of questions against current web evidence and return a reasoned answer for each one. Use it for a choice that should rest on up-to-date sources

advanced_settings.description: Optional settings, such as a location, a date to search after, or whether to include source excerpts.

mode.description: How much effort to spend, from the fastest setting to the most thorough.

state.description: The current state of the decision, including what is already known. Required.

questions.description: The questions to weigh against current web evidence. Required.

name: create_task_group
description: Create an empty task group so several related research runs can be tracked together. Use it before starting runs that belong to one job

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

name: retrieve_task_group
description: Return the details and status of one task group

taskgroup_id.description: The id of the task group, as returned when the group was created.

name: stream_task_group_events
description: Return the next event from a task group event feed, continuing from the last event id if one is given. Use it to follow the group while its runs work

taskgroup_id.description: The id of the task group, as returned when the group was created.

last_event_id.description: The id of the last event already seen, so the feed continues from the next one.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the next event before giving up, in seconds.

name: add_runs_to_task_group
description: Start one or more research runs inside a task group, each answering its input under a shared task specification. Use it to run a batch of related research in one call

taskgroup_id.description: The id of the task group, as returned when the group was created.

refresh_status.description: Set to true to refresh the run statuses before answering.

default_task_spec.description: The task specification every run in this call follows, unless a run carries its own.

inputs.description: The runs to start. Each entry is the input for one run.

name: fetch_task_group_runs
description: List the runs in a task group with their statuses, including inputs or outputs when asked for them

taskgroup_id.description: The id of the task group, as returned when the group was created.

last_event_id.description: The id of the last event already seen, so the feed continues from the next one.

status.description: Only return runs with this status.

include_input.description: Set to true to include each run input in the answer.

include_output.description: Set to true to include each run output in the answer.

name: retrieve_task_group_run
description: Return one run from a task group with its status and result

taskgroup_id.description: The id of the task group, as returned when the group was created.

run_id.description: The id of the run, as returned when the run was started.

name: create_task_run
description: Start a single deep research run that searches the web and writes a structured answer to the given input. Use it for a substantial research question that a quick search cannot settle

processor.description: The processor to run the research with. Heavier processors dig deeper and take longer. Required.

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

memory_scope_key.description: An optional key naming the research memory scope this work may draw on.

source_policy.description: Optional limits on which sources the run may use, such as domains to include or leave out.

advanced_settings.description: Optional extra settings for this call, such as limits on which sources may be used.

task_spec.description: An optional specification of the answer shape, such as a JSON schema for the output.

input.description: The question or material the run should research. Required.

previous_interaction_id.description: An optional earlier interaction to continue from.

mcp_servers.description: Optional extra tool servers the work may call.

enable_events.description: Set to true to emit progress events while the run works.

webhook.description: An optional web address to notify when the work finishes or reports.

name: retrieve_task_run
description: Return the current status of one task run

run_id.description: The id of the run, as returned when the run was started.

name: stream_task_run_events
description: Return events from a task run event feed as they arrive. The call stays open until the run finishes or the request times out, so use it only to watch a long run

run_id.description: The id of the run, as returned when the run was started.

name: retrieve_task_run_input
description: Return the exact input a task run was started with

run_id.description: The id of the run, as returned when the run was started.

name: retrieve_task_run_result
description: Return the finished result of a task run, waiting for it when it is still running

run_id.description: The id of the run, as returned when the run was started.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the run to finish before giving up, in seconds.

name: fast_entity_search
description: Quickly find people or companies that match an objective and return the best matches. Use it for a fast first pass before a full FindAll run

entity_type.description: Whether to look for people or companies.

objective.description: What the matches should be, stated in plain words.

name: ingest_findall_run
description: Start a FindAll search from a plain objective and let the service work out the matching criteria. Use it when the goal is clear but ready-made match conditions are not

objective.description: What the search should find, stated in plain words.

name: create_findall_run
description: Start a FindAll run that finds every person or company meeting the given match conditions, up to the match limit. Use it to build a list of entities that fit a description

objective.description: What the run should find, stated in plain words.

entity_type.description: The kind of entity to find, such as companies or people.

match_conditions.description: The conditions a match must meet. Each condition has a short name and a plain description.

generator.description: How thorough the search should be, from base up to preview.

exclude_list.description: An optional list of entities to leave out of the matches.

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

webhook.description: An optional web address to notify when the work finishes or reports.

memory_scope_key.description: An optional key naming the research memory scope this work may draw on.

name: retrieve_findall_run_status
description: Return the current status of one FindAll run

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

name: cancel_findall_run
description: Cancel a FindAll run that is still in progress

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

name: add_enrichment_to_findall_run
description: Add an enrichment step to a FindAll run so each match gains extra researched fields in the given output shape. Use it when the basic matches are not detailed enough

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

processor.description: The processor to do the enrichment research.

output_schema.description: The JSON shape each enriched match should follow.

mcp_servers.description: Optional extra tool servers the work may call.

name: stream_findall_events
description: Return the next event from a FindAll run event feed, continuing from the last event id if one is given. Use it to follow matches as they are found

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

last_event_id.description: The id of the last event already seen, so the feed continues from the next one.

timeout.description: How long to wait for the next event before giving up, in seconds.

name: extend_findall_run
description: Raise the match limit of a FindAll run so it can collect more matches than first allowed

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

additional_match_limit.description: How many more matches the run may collect.

name: findall_run_result
description: Return the matches collected by a FindAll run

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

name: get_findall_run_schema
description: Return the output schema a FindAll run was set up with

findall_id.description: The id of the FindAll run, as returned when the run was created.

name: create_monitor
description: Create a monitor that checks the web again and again on a schedule and reports new events or snapshots matching its settings. Use it when something needs watching over time

type.description: What the monitor produces: an event stream of new findings, or a snapshot each time it runs.

frequency.description: How often the monitor runs, such as every day.

processor.description: How much research effort each run uses: lite, base, or core.

webhook.description: An optional web address to notify when the work finishes or reports.

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

memory_scope_key.description: An optional key naming the research memory scope this work may draw on.

settings.description: What the monitor watches for, including its search query.

name: list_monitors
description: List monitors, with filters for type and status and paging for long lists

cursor.description: The cursor from a previous answer, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: The most monitors to return in one page.

type.description: Only return monitors of these types.

status.description: Only return monitors with these statuses.

name: monitor_stats
description: Return summary counts for monitors

name: retrieve_monitor
description: Return the details of one monitor

monitor_id.description: The id of the monitor, as returned when the monitor was created.

name: cancel_monitor
description: Cancel a monitor so it stops running

monitor_id.description: The id of the monitor, as returned when the monitor was created.

name: list_monitor_events
description: List the events a monitor has reported, with paging for long lists

monitor_id.description: The id of the monitor, as returned when the monitor was created.

event_group_id.description: Only return events that belong to this event group.

cursor.description: The cursor from a previous answer, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: The most events to return in one page.

include_completions.description: Set to true to include completed run records along with the events.

name: trigger_monitor_run
description: Run a monitor once right away, outside its usual schedule

monitor_id.description: The id of the monitor, as returned when the monitor was created.

name: update_monitor
description: Change a monitor, such as its type, schedule, processor, webhook, or settings

monitor_id.description: The id of the monitor, as returned when the monitor was created.

type.description: What the monitor produces: an event stream of new findings, or a snapshot each time it runs.

frequency.description: How often the monitor runs, such as every day.

processor.description: How much research effort each run uses: lite, base, or core.

webhook.description: An optional web address to notify when the work finishes or reports.

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

settings.description: What the monitor watches for, including its search query.

name: clear_research_memory
description: Clear saved research memory, for one scope when a scope key is given and otherwise in full. Use it when earlier research should no longer inform new work

memory_scope_key.description: The scope to clear. Leave out to clear all saved research memory.

name: evict_from_research_memory
description: Remove one task, monitor, or FindAll run from saved research memory so it no longer informs new work

memory_scope_key.description: The scope the entry was saved under, when it has one.

kind.description: The kind of entry to remove: a task, a monitor, or a FindAll run.

id.description: The id of the entry to remove.

name: retrieve_research_memory
description: Look up earlier research saved in memory and return the entries that best match. Use it to reuse past findings instead of researching again

query.description: What to look for in saved research.

kind.description: Only return entries of this kind: a task, a monitor, or a FindAll run.

since.description: Only return entries saved at or after this time.

memory_scope_key.description: The scope to look in, when the research was saved under one.

name: chat_completions
description: Send a conversation to a chat model and return its reply, read to the end when it streams. Use it for a direct model answer rather than a research run

model.description: The chat model that should answer.

messages.description: The conversation so far, as role and content pairs.

stream.description: Set to true to receive the reply as it is written.

name: create_response
description: Send input to a model and return its response. Use it for a direct model answer in the responses format

input.description: The prompt or conversation to answer.

instructions.description: Optional guidance for how the model should answer.

metadata.description: Optional labels to store with the record, as key and value pairs.

name: suggest_task
description: Turn a plain statement of intent into a ready-to-run research task specification. Use it when the goal is known but the task shape is not

user_intent.description: The goal, in the words the person used.

previous_task.description: An optional earlier task specification to revise.

name: suggest_processor
description: Recommend which processor should run a given task specification. Use it when a task is ready and the right depth of research is unclear

task_spec.description: The task specification to choose a processor for.

choose_processors_from.description: An optional list of processors to choose between.
